usage: The word 傷心 (seung1 sam1) is used as an adjective to describe the feeling of being heartbroken or very sad.
傷心 can modify a noun as an adjective, e.g. 傷心嘅故事 (heartbreaking story).
You can also use it to describe a person's emotional state, e.g. 我好傷心 (I am very heartbroken).
It often follows subject pronouns or people's names to describe how they feel.
傷心 is not used as a verb or noun standalone; usually it describes feelings or situations.
